name: dev.ucp.lodging.booking
title: Booking
description: Base booking schema. Extensions compose onto this using allOf.

status.description: Booking state indicating the current phase and required action. See Booking Status lifecycle documentation for state transition details.

accommodation.description: Accommodation location the booking is associated with.

room_rates.description: List of room and rate plan bindings for the booking.

booker.description: Representation of the legal contracting party making the reservation.

guests.description: List of guest profiles associated with the booking.

travel_purpose.description: Purpose of the trip or reservation. Well-known values: `business`, `leisure`. Businesses MAY implement and support additional values.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code reflecting the business's market determination. Derived from address, context, and geo IP—buyers provide signals, businesses determine currency.

messages.description: List of messages with error and info about the booking session state.

links.description: Links to be displayed by the platform (Privacy Policy, TOS). Mandatory for legal compliance.

policies.description: Policies (e.g., cancellation terms) that apply to the booking session. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root; when absent or empty, refer to the URLs in `links[]`.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiry timestamp. Default TTL is 6 hours from start if not sent.

continue_url.description: URL for booking handoff and session recovery. MUST be provided when status is requires_escalation. See specification for format and availability requirements.

confirmation.description: Details about the booking created from this specific session.
